The laptop and illustrative NPU models rendered by hardware.js, including their procedural textures, are original site assets dedicated to the public domain under CC0 1.0 (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/). The laptop does not use the bundled legacy Kenney model.
